capabilities: Render health visualization charts from health-viz code blocks
Filter chart data by date, datetime, and rolling windows
Generate and regenerate a Health Dashboard reference note
Insert visualizations via a command palette wizard
Configure data folder structure, file patterns, and formats
extras: Falls back to a bundled mock dataset when the data folder is empty; chart availability differs between iOS (HealthKit) and Android (Health Connect), with mood and medication views iOS-only.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn health tracking data files sitting in a vault into charts inside notes.

relations.evidence: Download Health.md on the App Store, or Health.md for Android on Google Play, to easily export and get access to your health data.
Add a health-viz block to your daily-note template (Templates or Templater plugin)

requires.name: Health.md app (Apple Health / Health Connect exports)

summary: Renders interactive Apple Health-style charts in notes from JSON, CSV, Markdown, or Bases health-export files stored in the vault.
